content:
Maria Desai: Heads up — monitoring picked up partner-ingest writing KMS-wrapped blobs into a public GCS bucket and we see a handful of reads from an unknown IP range. Possible credential leakage from partner CI. I'm starting containment now.
Carlos Nguyen: Ack. Do we have the exact objects and SA involved?
Maria Desai: Bucket: gs://partner-ingest-archive, objects: logs/2026-03-19/* (partial list), svcacct: partner-ingest-sa@redwood-prod. I pasted sample paths in the incident doc.
Priya Patel: Revoke the key ASAP and rotate any long-lived tokens. Suggest ephemeral tokens + short TTL for partner during recovery.
Ken O'Neil: I'll scope down the IAM binding to deny read from external IPs and add a conditional binding for internal CIDR. Doing now.
SRE Bot: Policy update applied to gs://partner-ingest-archive — removed allUsers read; added allow only from 10.0.0.0/8 and partner subnet. (change-id: ch_20260321_01)
Anna Fischer: We should also disable the GCP service account keys and create a new key with limited scopes. I'll run the key destroy command and hand off to Maria for vault rewrap.
Maria Desai: Running key disable: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable 0123456789abcdef --iam-account=partner-ingest-sa@redwood-prod.gserviceaccount.com`
Liam Grant: For KMS — rotate the key (create new key version and rewrap). Use `gcloud kms keys versions create` then re-encrypt stored ciphertext in vault conversion job. I can run the rewrap job once keys are in place.
Carlos Nguyen: We need to ensure Vault audit logs are enabled and forwarded to sec-logs before any re-issue. Add precise events: token create, token revoke, transit/rewrap.
Priya Patel: Onvault: enable audit devices: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` and forward via fluentd to gcp-logging.
Maria Desai: I'm triggering immediate revocation of any active tokens for that SA and removing its IAM roles. After that we'll rotate the KMS key.
Anna Fischer: Confirmed SA keys destroyed (one remaining key removed). Creating short-lived signed JWT flow for partner to onboard new ephemeral creds.
SRE Bot: Incident checklist step 3 complete: creds revoked. Step 4 scheduled: rewrap job at 2026-03-21T18:10Z.
Ken O'Neil: I pushed a temporary RBAC change: removed roles/storage.objectViewer from partner-ingest-sa in production projects. Rollback plan documented in the incident doc.
Liam Grant: Rewrap job ran on schedule. Spot-checked 50 objects; successful rewraps. I'll run a full checksum compare and publish results in ~30m.
Maria Desai: Also asked partner to rotate their CI tokens and provide proof of rotation. Shared secure contact (ops@partner).
Carlos Nguyen: We should add a conditional policy to KMS key to restrict decrypt to our rewrap service account only — prevents exfil via arbitrary clients.
Priya Patel: Agreed. Add KMS IAM: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` only to `serviceAccount:rewrap@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
Anna Fischer: Audit trail: enabling object-level access logs for the bucket and exporting to BigQuery for quick querying. I'll also pin a saved query for the incident.
Liam Grant: Full sweep finished: 100% rewrap success, no stale ciphertext remained. Posting results and hashes in the incident doc.
Maria Desai: Post-incident actions: 1) Force partner long-lived key retirement 2) Add CI lint to prevent printing KMS ciphertext into logs 3) Add alert for >5 object reads from unknown IP in 1h 4) Schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow.
Carlos Nguyen: I'll own #2 and #3 (adding the lint and alert).
Priya Patel: I'll draft the postmortem template and collect artifacts (audit logs, rewrap job runbook, IAM diffs).
Anna Fischer: Can we add an RBAC automation to auto-remove broad perms and require justification on granting? This would've reduced blast radius.
Ken O'Neil: Good idea — I'll prototype an enforced approval flow and tie it into OKTA groups.
SRE Bot: Security incident closed for containment phase. Followups assigned to owners. (incident-id: INC-20260321-09)
Maria Desai: Thanks team — containment & rotation done. We'll run the postmortem and share findings with partner. Closing thread once postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
